title: Comparative phylogenomics and transcriptional regulatory networks of AQPs, HSPs, and LEA proteins in salt-stressed Portulaca oleracea.
authors: da Silva, Thalliton Luiz Carvalho; Oliveira Braga, Italo de; Barbosa, Leticia Fonseca; Leao, Andre Pereira; Dos Santos, Wellington Rangel; Togawa, Roberto Coiti; Martins, Natalia Florencio; de Sousa, Carlos Antonio Ferreira; Junior, Manoel Teixeira Souza
journal: Plant science : an international journal of experimental plant biology
one_liner_zh: 该文利用深度学习基因组注释和基因调控网络推断研究盐胁迫下马齿苋的AQP/HSP/LEA蛋白，虽涉及转录因子调控网络，但核心是植物耐盐性转录组学，缺乏蛋白质-DNA三维互作建模或结合机制研究，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: Soil salinization severely threatens global food security, necessitating systematic investigations of halophytes like Portulaca oleracea to decode the molecular mechanisms of environmental resilience. Utilizing an integrated framework of deep learning-based genome annotation (58,817 predicted genes; 96.5% BUSCO completeness), multi-tissue RNA-Seq, phylogenomics, and gene regulatory network (GRN) inference, the synergistic orchestration of 78 aquaporins (AQPs), 525 heat shock proteins (HSPs), and 119 late embryogenesis abundant (LEA) proteins was elucidated. The active transcriptome, encompassing 39,065 expressed loci, revealed a systemic growth-defense trade-off. Tissues displayed distinct adaptive mechanisms: leaves modulated intracellular water balance via specialized AQPs, whereas adult roots maintained proteostasis through robust HSP20/HSP70 induction. Phylogenomic clustering across 154 species demonstrated that salinity tolerance constitutes an evolutionary mosaic, identifying 81 halophyte-exclusive orthogroups and 1129 species-specific clusters. Comparative topology across six independent GRNs (4.2M-5.3 M edges) unmasked a highly modular transcriptional reprogramming strategy governed by a core apparatus of 22 stress-exclusive regulators, with functional enrichment heavily prioritizing protein dimerization and chromatin remodeling. Theoretically, the distinct convergence of Trihelix transcription factors with guard cell differentiation pathways offers a candidate transcriptomic framework to explain the plant's characteristic C4-CAM photosynthetic plasticity under severe osmotic pressure. Practically, these evolutionary blueprints and specific master switches transcend single-gene transgenic limitations. Utilizing these root-sustained and stress-inducible targets under localized promoters provides a naturally optimized, network-level precision engineering roadmap to transfer robust, compartmentalized halotolerance to sensitive glycophytic crops.
abstract_zh: 土壤盐渍化严重威胁全球粮食安全，亟需对马齿苋（Portulaca oleracea）等盐生植物进行系统研究，以解码环境适应性的分子机制。通过整合基于深度学习的基因组注释（预测基因58,817个；BUSCO完整性96.5%）、多组织RNA-Seq、系统发育组学和基因调控网络（gene regulatory network, GRN）推断，阐明了78个水通道蛋白（aquaporins, AQPs）、525个热休克蛋白（heat shock proteins, HSPs）和119个晚期胚胎发生丰富蛋白（late embryogenesis abundant, LEA）的协同调控机制。活性转录组涵盖39,065个表达位点，揭示了系统性的生长-防御权衡。不同组织展现出独特的适应机制：叶片通过特异性AQPs调节细胞内水分平衡，而成体根系则通过强烈的HSP20/HSP70诱导维持蛋白质稳态。跨154个物种的系统发育聚类分析表明，耐盐性构成一种进化镶嵌体，鉴定出81个盐生植物特有直系同源群和1,129个物种特异性簇。六个独立GRN（4.2M-5.3M条边）的比较拓扑分析揭示了一种高度模块化的转录重编程策略，由22个胁迫特异调控因子的核心装置主导，功能富集显著偏向蛋白质二聚化和染色质重塑。理论上，Trihelix转录因子与保卫细胞分化途径的独特汇聚，为解释该植物在严重渗透胁迫下特有的C4-CAM光合可塑性提供了候选转录组框架。实践上，这些进化蓝图和特定主开关超越了单基因转基因的局限性。利用这些根系维持和胁迫诱导的靶标，在局部启动子驱动下，为将稳健、区室化的耐盐性转移至敏感糖类作物提供了一条自然优化的网络级精准工程路线图。
